label: Turtle Reconstruction
description: Generic vision-to-program prompt for reconstructing geometry with a motion-based turtle representation.
text: Reconstruct the complete source geometry as motion-based Turtle programs.
Prefer movement and rotation after establishing an initial position. Use pen width when several parallel pixels or cells can be represented exactly by one stroke.
Avoid replacing geometry with direct rectangle/block primitives when the operation requires a motion-based representation.
Preserve holes, disconnected strokes, exact topology, and changed-cell geometry.
